# routeros_system_console (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `port` (String) The name of the serial or USB port the console is bound to, as listed by `/port/print` (for example `serial0`).

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `channel` (Number) The console channel number that is attached to the port.
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `term` (String) The terminal type reported to the attached terminal, for example `vt102`, `vt100`, `linux` or `ansi`.

### Read-Only

- `default` (Boolean) It's the default item.
- `free` (Boolean) Whether the port is currently free (no session is attached to the console).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `used` (Boolean) Whether the console is currently in use.
- `vcno` (String) The number of the virtual console that is attached to the port.
- `wedged` (Boolean) Whether the console is stuck and does not accept input.
